text:
emily_marketing: heads-up team 1 — we need a tight SEO ops bundle for the webinar launch/post wave. scope: 1 landing, 1 hero post, 3 pillar posts, thanks page. deliver redirect CSV, keyword clusters, schema snippets, anchor map, and UTMs. target: ready for QA Tue EOD so redirects run Wed morning.

jordan_seo: I can own keyword clusters + canonical map. will keep clusters to 4 per page (primary + 3 longtails). plan to publish a small CSV and short notes.

maria_prod: messaging question 1: which value prop variant do we bake into meta descriptions? we have "fast predictable inference" vs "low-cost inference with controls".

aj_growth: from paid tests CTA "get started" variation performed worse. CTA "see demo" had better lift. recommend "see demo" in H1 and meta CTAs. use cold/remarket split: H1 -> see demo; remarket banners -> get started.

jordan_seo: good. i'll include CTA phrasing in meta description drafts. also recommending these quick redirect rules to avoid duplicate content during rollout: 

```csv
old_path,new_path,type,notes
/blog/wave-1, /blog/launch-hero,301,merge duplicate launch drafts
/webinar-2024, /webinar,302,temp while we validate tracking
/offer/try, /thanks,301,consolidate thank pages
```

jordan_seo: i'll flip the 302->301 after the tracker fires in staging.

sam_eng: schedule: we'll run the redirect job Wed 05:00-06:00 UTC. process: apply 302s, smoke test redirects + analytics, then convert to 301. SRE will watch.

maria_prod: anchors: hero post should link to pillar A and pillar C in the first third of the article, and to webinar landing in the CTA module. webinar landing should link to pillar B and thank-you page from the right rail. keep anchor text descriptive, not exact-match spam.

aj_growth: UTMs: use utm_source=mar_kit, utm_medium=cta, utm_campaign=webinar_apr24. add utm_content variants: hero_promo / email_invite / social_snippet. this feeds HubSpot routing rules.

jordan_seo: schema notes: webinar landing -> add schema:Event/Webinar JSON-LD with startDate/organizer/name/url and offers if gated. blog posts -> BlogPosting with mainEntityOfPage + image + author. i'll paste snippets to the ticket.

emily_marketing: perfect. one more ask: can we add rel=prev/next for the pillar cluster pagination and also check hreflang (we only support en-us for this campaign)?

sam_eng: rel prev/next ok. hreflang header will be set site-wide, we just need to ensure staging pages have the right lang tags.

jordan_seo: quick sample JSON-LD i'll attach later but here's a tiny inline example for the webinar page:

```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Launch Webinar","startDate":"2024-04-10T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```

maria_prod: thanks. i'll create the anchor map doc and paste copy variants. also updating the messaging heatmap with CTRs from last week (will include a short table).

emily_marketing: action list: jordan 1 deliver keyword clusters + redirect CSV + JSON-LD by Tue 11:00. maria 1 deliver anchor placements + CTA text by Tue 14:00. aj 1 confirm UTMs + heatmap by Tue 15:00. sam 1 schedule redirect job and confirm SRE standby. ops-bot: create ticket and set Tue reminders.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #MK-4121 "Webinar launch: SEO redirects, anchors, schema, UTMs" 1 assignees: jordan_seo, maria_prod, aj_growth, sam_eng. Reminder set for 2024-04-02T09:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

emily_marketing: thanks everyone 1 i'll do a preflight pass Tue after deliverables land. :rocket:
